design_philosophy: Warm, tactile, and frictionless. The interface must feel like a natural extension of a cozy cafe. Using generous spacing, soft geometry, and earthy tones to reduce cognitive load during busy shifts.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous padding. Elements should never feel cramped.

components_strategy.product_card: Vertical layout. Image on top (aspect-square, rounded-t-2xl, object-cover). Body with title and price (Rp). Subtle border, changes to Primary color border on hover/active. Clicking the whole card adds to cart.
components_strategy.cart_sidebar: Desktop: Fixed right panel. White background, border-left. Divided into 3 vertical flex areas: Header (Order Info), Middle (Scrollable list of selected items with + / - quantity controls), Bottom (Fixed summary, subtotal, tax, massive Primary Pay button).
components_strategy.category_pills: Horizontal scrollable flex container. Active: bg-primary text-white. Inactive: bg-white text-text_secondary border border-border.
components_strategy.login_page: Split screen layout. Left: high-res cafe aesthetic image with 20% black overlay and brand welcome text. Right: clean, centered login form (username/password) in a card with subtle shadow.
components_strategy.payment_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Large touch-friendly options: Cash, Transfer, QRIS. QRIS selection shows a generated QR code image.
components_strategy.mobile_optimizations: Products in 2-column grid. Cart is hidden behind a fixed bottom floating action button (FAB) 'View Cart - Rp Total' which opens a Shadcn Sheet from bottom. Touch targets min 48px height.

icons_and_assets.style: Regular weight, 24px default size, rounded caps.

login_background.description: Warm interior of a coffee shop, ideal for the split-screen login page background.

product_coffee_1.description: Cafe latte art for a coffee product.

product_coffee_2.description: White ceramic cup with coffee on wooden table.

product_pastry_1.description: Two brown croissants for a pastry product.

qris_placeholder.description: Generated QR code for QRIS payment modal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with `Manrope` font from Google Fonts. Extend the color palette exactly as specified in `colors`.

For the POS Dashboard layout, wrap the top-level container in `h-screen overflow-hidden` to avoid window scrolling. Use CSS Grid for desktop: sidebar navigation (col-span-1 or fixed w-20), main product area (flex-1), and cart panel (w-[400px]).
Inner sections (product grid, cart items list) MUST have `overflow-y-auto`.
Implement currency formatting for IDR consistently: `Rp {amount.toLocaleString('id-ID')}`.
The cart items list must clearly show quantity adjusters (+ and - buttons) taking up substantial touch area (e.g., `w-8 h-8`).
For mobile view (md:hidden), the Cart Panel should be rendered inside a Shadcn Sheet that pops up from the bottom, triggered by a sticky bottom FAB.
Ensure the QRIS payment tab clearly shows the QR code centered with instructions to scan.
Do NOT use thick card borders unless specified. Rely on subtle shadows (`shadow-card_subtle`) and backgrounds for elevation.
Add `data-testid` to all actionable items: login-form-submit-button, category-[id], product-[id], add-to-cart-[id], checkout-btn, pay-cash-btn, pay-qris-btn.
